criteria.text: `src/db.ts` exports `Db`, `clampEnv`, `poolConfig`, `db`, `schema`, `migrate`, `ANALYZED_TABLES`, `AnalyzedTable`, `analyzeMinDocs`, `analyzeTables`, `analyzeAfterWrite` with the same call signatures as today; every current importer (`graph.ts`, `aggregate.ts`, `server.ts`, `phrases.ts`, `reindex.ts`, `purge.ts`, `push.ts`, `score.ts`, `export-docs.ts`, `migrate.ts`, `gkg.ts`) compiles with no source change beyond, at most, an import path.

`poolConfig` stays pure and synchronous: given a `postgres://` URL it returns a config object without opening a socket, throws the same message as today when `PG_SSL_CA` is unset for a non-local host, and returns `ssl: undefined` for `localhost`/`127.0.0.1` with or without `PG_SSL_CA` set.
`poolConfig`'s pool-size field is `PG_POOL_MAX`-clamped 1..20, default 3, and its connect-timeout field resolves to 10 seconds — both asserted by test, field names whatever `PgPoolConfig` requires.
With no `DATABASE_URL`/`POSTGRES_URL`, `db` answers a trivial query (`select 1`) against an embedded PGlite instance, at `DATA_DIR` or in-memory for `memory://`, exactly as `embedded()` does today.
With `DATABASE_URL`/`POSTGRES_URL` set, `db` is built from `poolConfig`'s output through `@effect/sql-pg`, never through `pg.Pool` — no code path in `src/db.ts` imports `pg` for this driver.

`PERF=1` still wraps `db.query`/`db.exec` with `perf.ts`'s `instrument`, and its Proxy's `typeof value === 'function'` check finds both — an existing or new test on the returned object's shape passes.
`inTransaction(fn)` keeps its `<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>) => Promise<T>` signature; `store.ts` no longer holds a module-level `open` flag.

A nested `inTransaction` whose inner call throws and is caught by the outer rolls back only the inner's writes; the outer's own writes made before and after the inner call remain when the outer commits.
A nested `inTransaction` whose outer call throws rolls back every write made by both inner and outer.
A `db.query`/`db.exec` call made directly inside an `inTransaction` callback (not through a `store.ts` writer) reads that transaction's own uncommitted rows.
`test/graph.test.ts`'s frozen-`now()` transaction block (the `inTransaction` + thrown-sentinel `rollback` pattern, currently around lines 945-983) passes unchanged.
A `db.query`/`db.exec` call made with no open `inTransaction` runs outside any transaction, as today.

`store.ts`'s `pruneRemoved`, `upsertPersons`, `writeDerived`, `insertDoc`, `insertDocs` keep their current Promise signatures and behavior; `test/store.test.ts`'s existing suite passes unchanged; `ingest.ts`, `reindex.ts`, `push.ts` and `test/fixture.ts` need no source change.

Each of those five writers has an `Effect`-suffixed counterpart (`pruneRemovedEffect`, `upsertPersonsEffect`, `writeDerivedEffect`, `insertDocEffect`, `insertDocsEffect`) typed as an `Effect` requiring `SqlClient.SqlClient` and failing with `SqlError`, and produces the same written/enriched/failed counts and the same rows as its Promise counterpart for the same input.
`aggregate.ts` needs no source change; `test/aggregate.test.ts` passes unchanged.

`package.json` adds `@effect/sql-pglite` and `@effect/sql-pg` at `4.0.0-rc.117` (no `@effect/sql`: those modules are `effect/unstable/sql`); `pg` and `@types/pg` remain listed (see §6) and `src/push.ts` is untouched.
`pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass, with no test file outside `test/db.test.ts`/`test/store.test.ts` needing an edit for a reason other than an import path.

The docs (checked against `docsText`, across every page) state that database driver selection follows `DATABASE_URL`/`POSTGRES_URL` between an embedded and a managed Postgres client, and keep present the facts that `PG_SSL_CA` is required for a non-local host, that the connection-pool size defaults to 3 and clamps to 1..20 via `PG_POOL_MAX`, and that `PG_SSL_CA` must be set before a deploy against a non-local database. `test/docs-drift.test.ts` does not cover this (it pins the collector/source registry only); no criterion here overlaps it.

`CLAUDE.md`'s description of `src/db.ts`/`src/store.ts` states that a transaction is always opened through `inTransaction` (Promise call sites) or `sql.withTransaction` (Effect call sites), never a raw `begin`/`commit`/`rollback` string.

Manual, pre-merge, by a human with `.env.local` (`vercel env pull`), on a `DATA_DIR`/worktree the builder alone owns: `pnpm migrate` succeeds and one `pnpm bench` round completes with matching `/api/people` row counts against both `POSTGRES_URL` (the pooler, transaction-mode, port 6543) and `POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING`. This gate is not satisfied by green CI alone — CI never sets `DATABASE_URL`.
